Iran's state media reported an "enemy" military strike on the IRGC's Shahid Rahbari naval base at Sirik near the Strait of Hormuz. Secondhand reports indicate a large number of missiles launched in western Iran around 1400Z.

sections.executive_summary: Israel struck Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail at Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, where the IDF says hostages were held. Iran's state media reported an "enemy" military strike on the IRGC's Shahid Rahbari naval base at Sirik near the Strait of Hormuz. Secondhand reports indicate a large number of missiles launched in western Iran around 1400Z.

points: Iran's state news agency IRNA reported that Sirik in Hormozgan province on the Strait of Hormuz was hit by an "enemy" strike described as "military in nature"; Sirik hosts the IRGC's Shahid Rahbari naval base, and no actor has claimed responsibility (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9922).

Secondhand information from a monitoring channel indicated a large number of missiles were launched in western Iran at approximately 1400Z (17:30 Tehran time), with a 120-second delayed posting (Source: @shin_persian/12333).

Iranian media reported mass funerals across the country for 350 unidentified "campaign casualties," with a central ceremony at Tehran University for 110 attended by Iran's president and IRGC commander General Vahidi (Source: @yediotnews25/137780).

An observation near Tabriz in East Azerbaijan Province described a stationary luminous object in the sky over the Bostanabad road; after several seconds its light went out, revealing faint blue and red lights, assessed as possibly a reconnaissance UAV (Source: @shin_persian/12325).

The US Army stated that two drones were launched toward Bahrain and intercepted, with no damage or casualties, in response to Iranian claims of hitting a US radar system in Bahrain (Source: @N12chat/234886).

In an interview, former President Trump said he could "end" Iran immediately but noted some nations, specifically Saudi Arabia, had requested a more civic approach and to let the situation remain as it is (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9918, @Faytuks_Network/9917).

The IDF and Shin Bet struck Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail at Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis; the military says the hospital's second floor serves as a Hamas military headquarters where civilians are barred, and that dozens of hostages from Kibbutz Nahal Oz were held there throughout the war (Source: @manniefabian/59513).

US Fifth Fleet Commander Vice Admiral Kurt Renshaw concluded a visit to Israel hosted by Israeli Navy Chief Major General Eyal Harel; discussions covered naval operations across theaters, regional stability, maritime security, fleet coordination, and technological knowledge sharing (Source: @yediotnews25/137786).

Mossad chief Roman Gofman visited Washington, meeting CIA Director John Ratcliffe, with a planned meeting with US envoy Steve Witkoff in Miami, amid reported pressure from Netanyahu to renew war with Iran (Source: @N12chat/234891).

Prime Minister Netanyahu and former Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot held a security briefing; Eisenkot was updated on security and diplomatic challenges, with agreement on continued mutual updates (Source: @amitsegal/67176).
A Red Alert incident at Nachal Oz Tzofar ended at 03:00 on 13/11/2026 (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68585).

IDF and Shin Bet arrested four terrorists advancing terror plots in the Menashe Brigade sector of the West Bank, including two identified with ISIS; they were transferred for interrogation (Source: @N12chat/234887).

The IDF struck Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail at Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis; alongside him, engineering team commander Muawad Tawfiq Mahmoud Abu Zarifa and intelligence communications head Khaled Osama Abu Anza were targeted (Source: @manniefabian/59513).
Palestinian media reported an explosive device detonated on the roof of the Hassan Allah family home in the Zeitoun neighborhood in southeast Gaza City (Source: @yediotnews25/137791).
IDF and Shin Bet arrested four terrorists in the Menashe Brigade area, including two ISIS-affiliated operatives, who were promoting terror attack plans (Source: @N12chat/234887).

The IDF stated that throughout the war, dozens of hostages were held at Nasser Hospital, including Sgt. 1st Class Nimrod Cohen, Sgt. 1st Class Idan Alexander, Matan Zangauker, Avera Mengistu, and the bodies of Col. Asaf Hamami, Staff Sgt. Oz Daniel, and Capt. Omer Neutra (Source: @manniefabian/59513).
Five Hezbollah operatives were arrested in a Christian town in northern Lebanon on suspicion of espionage (Source: @yediotnews25/137793).
Israeli warplanes were reported over southern Lebanon, with live map tracking shown (Source: @redlinkleb/53056, @redlinkleb/53057).
Artillery shelling was reported at Zoutar Al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon (Source: @redlinkleb/53045).
An Israeli drone dropped a bomb on the outskirts of the town of Mifdon in southern Lebanon (Source: @redlinkleb/53038).
Military helicopters were observed landing in Al-Dora, Baghdad, Iraq (Source: @shin_persian/12321, @shin_persian/12322).
The US Army stated two drones launched toward Bahrain were intercepted with no damage or casualties, countering Iranian claims of hitting a US radar system there (Source: @N12chat/234886).
Saudi civil defense issued a warning of danger in the Jazan area (Source: @N12chat/234894).

Former President Trump said Saudi Arabia requested a more civic approach to Iran and to let the situation remain as it is, because "they're falling apart" (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9918, @Faytuks_Network/9917).

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous escalation in Gaza, Lebanon, and Iran indicates a coordinated multi-front pressure campaign. Israel's strike on a senior Hamas commander inside a hospital signals willingness to target leadership in protected sites, risking international condemnation. The reported strike on Iran's strategic naval base at Sirik, if confirmed as Israeli, marks a significant escalation in direct attacks on IRGC infrastructure. Missile launches in western Iran suggest either Iranian retaliatory readiness or internal instability. Hezbollah arrests in northern Lebanon reveal Israeli intelligence penetration deep into Hezbollah's rear areas. The convergence of US naval leadership visits, Mossad-CIA meetings, and Saudi diplomatic positioning points to active contingency planning for broader conflict.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia's civil defense warning in Jazan and its reported request to the US for restraint on Iran reflect Gulf anxiety over escalation. The US Fifth Fleet commander's visit to Israel and Mossad chief's Washington meetings demonstrate deepening US-Israel military coordination. Lebanon's arrest of Hezbollah operatives in a Christian town suggests internal Lebanese security actions possibly coordinated with or independent of Israeli intelligence. Iran's mass funerals for 350 unidentified casualties signal ongoing attrition in undisclosed operations, while state media's "enemy strike" language at Sirik avoids direct attribution, preserving deniability. The region appears to be bracing for further kinetic exchanges.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Nasser Hospital strike reveals Israeli intelligence on Hamas command-and-control and hostage locations within medical facilities. The Sirik strike targets a key IRGC naval asset controlling the Strait of Hormuz chokepoint. Missile launches in western Iran could indicate dispersal of missile forces or retaliatory posture. The Al-Dora helicopter activity in Baghdad may relate to Iranian-backed militia movements or Iraqi security operations. The Menashe Brigade arrests of ISIS-affiliated operatives highlight the persistent Salafi-jihadist threat in the West Bank alongside Hamas. The convergence of diplomatic (Mossad-CIA, US Navy) and kinetic actions suggests a decision cycle accelerating toward either a major escalation or a negotiated de-escalation window.
